description: This file implements storage management for a note-taking application, including functions to initialize, load, save, create, retrieve, update, and delete notes, with thread safety and sample data seeding.

methods.name: _load_raw
methods.description: Loads raw note data from the JSON file, returning an empty list if file does not exist or is invalid.

methods.name: _save_raw
methods.description: Saves the provided list of note dictionaries to the JSON file.

methods.name: _seed_if_empty
methods.description: Seeds the storage with sample notes if the data file is empty.

methods.name: _next_id
methods.description: Calculates the next available note ID based on existing notes.
